year old female patient with seizure "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"This is an online e log book to discuss our patient de-identified health data shared after taking his \/ her \/ guardians signed Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 65yr old female resident of lingotum with history of seizures\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EChief complaints:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient was brought to casuality with chief complaints of Active involuntary movements ,since 30 minutes, history of frothing , mouth deviation to left\u0026nbsp; uprolling eyeball ,no h\/o of tongue bite, urinary incontinence, fever, head injury, vomitings, loose stools.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 30 mins back later she developed sudden onset of movements in upper and lower limbs for 5 minutes.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cu style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); letter-spacing: normal;\"\u003Etypical episode\u003C\/u\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); letter-spacing: normal;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;begins with headache and dizziness, up-rolling of the eyes followed by loss of consciousness and uncontrolled involuntary movements of the arms and legs, clasping of the hands and deviation of the mouth to one side. Frothing and tongue bite was seen in the initial years. She usually regains consciousness 5-10 minutes later in a confused state, with no memory of the episode. There have been instances of falling to the floor when no one was around to help her.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECurrent presentation -\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECurrent episode began in the night time she also had complaints of headache dragging type pain radiating to neck . This was followed by uprolling of the eyeballs loss of consciousness and sudden onset of involuntary movements,\u0026nbsp; frothing,\u0026nbsp; deviation of mouth towards left and confusion in postictal period.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"letter-spacing:
